{{Top|leg}}
A '''warkeeper''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] creature. It was 22 meters long, [[Slug/Legends|slug]]-like, and had an armored shell studded with spiny growths which could fire [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] globs. [[Dovin basal]]s were implanted into the creatures for defense purposes. They were designed as a defender and protector to a [[thrall]] [[Thrall herder|herder]]. [[Warrior caste|Warriors]] commanding the warkeeper had to keep thralls from wandering into the range of the dovin basal gravity field and being consumed.
